title: Production Readiness Audit
prompt: Review a small app against a checklist for input, authorization, secrets, logging, tests, deployment, and rollback. Learning objective from the source syllabus: Add tests, logging, validation, security checks, and deployment configuration. Use synthetic data and local files only. This task is a practice brief, not a remotely executed C# sandbox.
objective: Add tests, logging, validation, security checks, and deployment configuration.
target_skills: Add tests, logging, validation, security checks, and deployment configuration.
expected_output: A C# solution satisfying the stated behavior and acceptance criteria. Record representative expected results in tests or sample output; verify with `dotnet test` or `dotnet run` locally as appropriate.
acceptance_criteria: The program satisfies the stated task: Review a small app against a checklist for input, authorization, secrets, logging, tests, deployment, and rollback.
The code uses appropriate C# types and keeps the main responsibility readable.
Normal behavior and at least one boundary/failure condition are checked.
No secrets or real personal data are included.
The learner explains the trade-off or limitation in their own words.
hints: Write down inputs, outputs, and invalid states before coding.
Start with one happy-path test, then add boundary/failure tests.
The current repository grader performs text/token validation only; compile and run the C# code locally for real behavior.
grading_method: Static required-string smoke check only. This does not execute C# or prove correctness. Run the project locally with the compatible .NET SDK and complete the acceptance-criteria review.
retry_policy: Allow retries. Correctness and any XP award are determined by the platform backend; this course file defines no XP override.
status_note: Draft exercise based on Section C of C#(1).pdf. Review grading tokens and execute the reference solution in a .NET project before publication.
